answer.says: Ramesh, you may go. I shall wait here.
answer.thought: The body is satisfied for the moment by this small, unmediated gift. I remain in the study, the silence of the house now heavy with the anticipation of the state's reply. The file is gone for fifteen days; I must let the thought of it rest until it returns, for anxiety is merely freedom suspended. I will sit in the dark and let the brown haze outside mirror the indeterminacy within.
